comment: The repo's test-suite roster, DECLARED ONCE and read by BOTH entry points: the FAKE
`Test` target in Build.fs (`dotnet run --project Build.fsproj -- Test`) and `run.ps1`.
Order is significant and is the order both run them in.
`project` is repo-relative and forward-slashed; both readers normalise separators.
`requiresCorpus` (default false) marks a suite that loads the wire-format conformance
corpus from a sibling of this repo: present in a workspace checkout, absent in a
single-repo checkout (e.g. the publish-packages workflow), where the suite would crash
at startup. Both readers skip those loudly rather than run them.
`note` is documentation only — no reader consults it.

suites.note: Language-tier integration tests, including the generated-layer coverage assertions over the corpus as a set.
Phase 512 — the public signature-searchable pattern bank (engine + domain-neutral seed catalogue).
Phase 178 — branching op-stream DAG (opt-in, rung-4). Its own project so the DAG suite runs alongside the linear op-stream suite without coupling the linear consumers to the DAG packages.
Phase 186 — DAG-aware op-stream inspector substrate (render model + audition + overlay + arbitrary-coordinate diff).
The wire-format conformance suite. Its own fail-loud-if-absent contract is intact on the corpus-present path; the gate here decides whether to invoke it at all.
Phase 142 — the SSR client/server class+ARIA parity corpus. Also runnable on its own via the `SsrParity` target.
Phase 158 QW6 — the golden TreeOp -> DomPatch lowering corpus. Also runnable on its own via the `DomPatchCorpus` target.
Host-neutral validated-exemplar seam (decodeExemplar + 3-gate integrity). Corpus-independent — builds a node, encodes, and checks the round-trip fixed point.

Phase 380 — the certified fragment library. Drives every entry in `Stdlib.all` through the Phase 359 certification floor plus the template / reference consistency checks. The wire fixtures for the same fragments live in the shared corpus and are gated by the JsonDecode suite; this one runs unconditionally.
Page-set layer (SitePage + SiteCheck + Nav projection + RenderPlan + static-export planning). Pure + corpus-independent.
Phase 205 — structure-only clean room (content-free skeleton projection + structural-op gate + audit). Pure + Fable-clean.

Phase 169 — catalog wire-JSON round-trip guard. Compile-links the catalog's Matrix.fs and asserts every entry's canonical JSON decodes back through the canonical decoder, so the "the JSON shown next to the render is real" promise is build-time-checked.

Phase 1181 — the generated-layer drift guard, in-process. Regenerates src/Fuaran.UI/Generated.fs from this repo's own idl.json + support.json through the packaged IDL engine and byte-compares. Reads nothing outside this repo and fails (never skips) if it cannot find its inputs.
Phase 172 — C# fluent-builder authoring-shape PoC. A console harness that proves C#-authored trees encode byte-identically to the corpus; runs as a wire-identity gate (exit non-zero on divergence).
Phase 306 — the C# authoring veneer's corpus-conformance suite (the supportable promotion of the PoC's byte-compare harness).
Phase 314 — the Roslyn analyzer's test suite (drives the analyzer over source snippets). Corpus-independent.
Phase 315 — the VB XML-literal analyzer's test suite. Corpus-independent.
Phase 312 — the VB XML-literal veneer's corpus-conformance suite (a VB console runner, since XML literals are a VB language feature).
